description.en: Four rows print small sites and secondary structure: Electric 15, Electric 10 Series, the rural diesel pump and the tractor-driven 4100. Distances are not shared.
description.zh: 四行印了小型工地与二次结构：电动15、电动10系列、农村柴油泵和拖拉机带动4100。距离并不共用。

directAnswer.en: Four catalogue rows from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai: Electric 15, Electric 10 Series, the Rural Diesel Concrete Pump and the Tractor-Driven 4100. Each also says rural self-built houses and short-to-medium pipelines. Electric 15 is 15 kW, 8–10 m³/h, 15–20 m vertical, 60–80 m horizontal, 1–3 cm and 450 kg. Electric 10 Series is 15 kW, 21 m³/h, 23 MPa, 25 m horizontal only, 2 cm and below and 400 kg. The rural diesel is 17 kW, 5–8 m³/h, 30–50 m horizontal, 10–30 m vertical. The 4100 prints 40 kW, 6–12 m³/h, 40–100 m / 15–45 m and slump 180–220 mm.
directAnswer.zh: 邢台河北品锦机械的四行目录：电动15、电动10系列、农村自建房柴油混凝土泵和拖拉机带动4100。每一行也写了农村自建房和中短距离管路。电动15是 15 kW、8–10 m³/h、垂直 15–20 m、水平 60–80 m、1–3 cm、450 kg。电动10系列是 15 kW、21 m³/h、23 MPa、只有水平 25 m、2 cm 及以下、400 kg。农村柴油泵是 17 kW、5–8 m³/h、水平 30–50 m、垂直 10–30 m。4100 印的是 40 kW、6–12 m³/h、40–100 m / 15–45 m，以及坍落度 180–220 mm。

heading.en: The shared sentence is not a shared table
heading.zh: 同一句话不是同一张表

body.en: Secondary structure does not copy Electric 15’s 60–80 m onto the Electric 10 Series, which stops at 25 m horizontal and has no vertical cell. It does not copy the 4100’s 40–100 m onto the 17 kW rural diesel. Electric 20’s building sentence is a different application line. Do not move a secondary-structure inquiry there while the pipe still fits a compact row.
body.zh: 二次结构不会把电动15的 60–80 m 抄到电动10系列上。电动10系列水平停在 25 m，而且没有垂直格。它也不会把 4100 的 40–100 m 抄到 17 kW 农村柴油泵上。电动20的建筑句是另一条应用。管路还落在紧凑行里时，不要把二次结构询盘挪过去。

heading.en: Grid or not decides the pair
heading.zh: 有没有电网决定哪一对

body.en: With a grid and a vertical run inside 15–20 m, start at Electric 15. With a grid and only a short 25 m horizontal run, Electric 10 Series is the printed horizontal cell. Without a pump-motor supply, the named rural machine is the 17 kW diesel, and the tractor-driven sheet is the 4100. B500S-83D is a separate 5 m tight-site unit and does not use the secondary-structure sentence.
body.zh: 有电网且垂直在 15–20 m 内，从电动15开始。有电网且只有 25 m 水平短管，电动10系列才是那个水平格。没有泵用电机电源时，点名的农村机器是 17 kW 柴油泵，拖拉机带动参数页是 4100。B500S-83D 是单独的 5 m 狭小场地机，没有使用二次结构这句话。

heading.en: What should Xingtai receive with the inquiry?
heading.zh: 向邢台询盘要带上什么？

body.en: Say whether the site has grid power, and which of the four distance windows the pipe fits. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print.
body.zh: 请说明现场有没有电网，以及管路落在四段距离窗口的哪一段。 请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。

answer.en: No. Its scenario is building and commercial placement.
answer.zh: 没有。它的工况是建筑与商业浇筑。

answer.en: Electric 15, the rural diesel and the 4100. Electric 10 Series prints 2 cm and below.
answer.zh: 电动15、农村柴油泵和 4100。电动10系列印的是 2 cm 及以下。

question.en: Is a column or beam volume printed?

answer.en: No. Match the compact row. Do not add a member size the catalogue does not print.
answer.zh: 没有。对照紧凑行即可。不要添加目录没印的构件尺寸。
